basics.name: Romain Racamier-Lafon
basics.summary: Tech Lead and front-end specialist, 15 years of experience across 5 consecutive lead roles. I take over front-ends that have drifted — Vue 2 to Vue 3, JavaScript to TypeScript, AngularJS to React — and hand back a shared component library, tools and a test suite the team can maintain without me. I have led teams of 2 to 8 developers at Eu-Lisa, Amundi WeSave and Collectif Energie: architecture, technical standards, code review, recruitment and mentoring, a role I also fill as a volunteer for people retraining into the field. Maintainer of multiple open-source projects.

volunteer.summary: I guide students as well as working professionals looking for a career change, helping them become web developers or simply discover the job. The exchanges happen over video calls, where I answer their questions: what a developer’s day really looks like, which studies matter, the skills and salary to aim for, where to learn. I also review their CVs and support them through the job hunt.

I guide several students in navigating their career paths and making informed decisions in the job market. I follow the same people over months or years, reviewing their CVs and applications, but most of the time the support is human before it is professional: helping them through the stress, anxiety and self-doubt that hold them back or slow them down.
